channel.title: The Grant Desk - Design, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Design, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 4 new Design grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Stimuleringsfonds: Design Sector Internationalisation Grant Scheme 2026
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/design-sector-internationalisation-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · EUR 10,000 to EUR 50,000. Minimum 20 percent co-financing. Round budget EUR 300,000 (2026 total EUR 600,000). No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Platforms for Design-based Learning 2026
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-platforms-for-design-based-learning
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 75,000 per application, from a total budget of EUR 720,000. No application fee.
  • AHRC: Design Generators Round Two (2026)
    https://www.ukri.org/opportunity/design-generators-round-two/
    Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), UK Research and Innovation · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · GBP 150,000 to 200,000 per project at 100 percent full economic cost; AHRC funds 80 percent and the host research organisation must cover the remaining 20 percent. Total fund GBP 1,000,000, approximately 5 awards. Covers research staff time, design prototyping, partner costs and public engagement activity. Subcontractors and PhD studentships are not fundable. No application fee.
  • Architecture Kick Start Grant Scheme
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/architecture-kick-start-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 07 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 total project budget including co-financing. Round budget EUR 167,000. Maximum 35 applications per period, ordered by random draw. No application fee.

item.title: 8 new Design grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• CrafTopia Creative Hub: Material Dialogues Textile Waste Residency 2026 (Thessaloniki, Greece)
    https://craftopia.gr/2026/05/18/open-call-material-dialogues-paper-textiles-and-contemporary-craft/
    CrafTopia Creative Hub (under Culture Moves Europe, funded by the European Union and the Goethe-Institut) · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Accommodation; shared working space; mentoring; networking opportunities; travel reimbursement; access to materials; administrative and logistical support; daily allowance (Culture Moves Europe standard). No application fee.
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Year Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-year-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. Monthly EUR 1,000 bursary for pre-agreed contracted months; free onsite accommodation (separate to studio); access to an onsite IMMA studio (if required); amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); one return journey for residents living outside Ireland; pre-agreed material/programming expenses related to the Research Assemblies. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable.
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Year Studio Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-year-studio-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. EUR 4,000 bursary for the year; free access to an onsite IMMA studio; amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); pre-agreed material/programming expenses related to the Research Assemblies. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable. NO accommodation provided (apply to one of the other two Dwell Here calls if accommodation is needed).
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Month Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-month-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. EUR 250/week bursary for pre-agreed contracted weeks; free shared onsite accommodation (with own bedroom, separate to studio); access to a shared onsite IMMA studio (if required); amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); one return journey for residents living outside Ireland. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable. NOTE: cannot support accommodation for additional family members or partners.
  • Jan van Eyck Academie: Material Research Fellowships 2027 (Future Materials)
    https://www.janvaneyck.nl/calendar/2-material-research-fellowships-2027/
    Jan van Eyck Academie (Future Materials / Future Threads programme, co-funded by the EU Just Transition Fund) · deadline Closed 24 Jun 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 1,750 (80% exempt from income tax) plus an annual working budget of EUR 2,250, a private studio apartment, and access to the Jan van Eyck Labs and external partners. Application fee EUR 50 excl. VAT (waived for applicants from DAC-list lower-income countries and territories).
  • Van Alen Institute: Open Access - Open Call for Exhibition Proposals 2026
    https://www.vanalen.org/project/open-access/
    Van Alen Institute · deadline Closed 28 Jun 2026 · USD 3,000 honorarium, plus archival access, curatorial support, mentorship, free materials via Materials for the Arts, professional documentation, and inclusion in the public exhibition. Five projects selected. No application fee.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme Autumn 2027 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
